title: Aina za Sentensi (Theme 12: Magonjwa yasiyoambukizwa)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child finds the main clause and the dependent clause (amba-, -po-, -ki-, kwa sababu) and builds a complex sentence.
steps: Find each verb and its clause.
contexts: non-communicable diseases: Wanaofanya mazoezi hupunguza hatari

board.do: Wanafunzi wanaofanya mazoezi huwa na afya.

board.say: Sehemu hii inaweza kusimama peke yake?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child marks the clauses and writes one complex sentence with amba-.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Sentensi changamano ina nini?" Kwa nini "kishazi kimoja tu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Changamano ina kishazi huru na tegemezi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kishazi tegemezi hufanya nini?" Kwa nini "kinajitegemea" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni sentensi ipi ni changamano?" Kwa nini "Mtoto analia." si jibu sahihi?
Sehemu hii inaweza kusimama peke yake?
misconceptions.repair: Kishazi tegemezi (ambaye alianguka) hufanya sentensi kuwa changamano.

checks.question: Unganisha kuwa changamano: "Mgonjwa alitibiwa. Alikuwa na kisukari."
checks.answer: Mgonjwa ambaye alikuwa na kisukari alitibiwa.
